metadata.name: My Custom AIOstreams Setup - Debrid & Polish Focus
metadata.description: My custom AIOstreams setup with a focus on Real-Debrid, TorBox and Polish content, featuring specific preferences for resolutions, qualities, languages, and more. It includes custom stream expressions and a unique formatter for an enhanced browsing experience.
metadata.author: piotrek1488

requiredStreamExpressions.expression: (queryType == 'anime.series' or queryType == 'anime.movie') ? intersect(language(streams, 'Japanese'), merge(language(streams, 'Japanese'), language(streams, 'English'), language(streams, 'Polish')), merge(subtitle(streams, 'Polish'), subtitle(streams, 'English'))) : streams

library(language(streams, 'Polish')) ? library(language(streams, 'Polish')) : library(streams) ? library(streams) : cached(language(streams, 'Polish')) ? cached(language(streams, 'Polish')) : cached(streams) ? cached(streams) : uncached(language(streams, 'Polish')) ? uncached(language(streams, 'Polish')) : uncached(streams)

preferredStreamExpressions.expression: library(language(streams, 'Polish')) ? library(language(streams, 'Polish')) : library(streams) ? library(streams) : cached(language(streams, 'Polish')) ? cached(language(streams, 'Polish')) : cached(streams) ? cached(streams) : uncached(language(streams, 'Polish')) ? uncached(language(streams, 'Polish')) : uncached(streams)
